style.styleTitle: Homcom 6ft Artificial Geneva Fir Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Christmas made simple, forever more. This HOMCOM artificial Christmas tree is a mess-free must-have addition to the season ahead. Crafted with 1610 dense PE and PVC branch tips, it showcases a Geneva Fir shape for a lush, realistic Christmas tree look. Flame-retardant materials offer added peace of mind, while a 3-section trunk with hinged branch tips ensures straightforward setup and compact storage. Complete with a foldable steel base, this Christmas tree keeps steady and balanced. . Distinctive Geneva Fir shape features a full-bodied, dense profile for a natural festive look; . Crafted with realistic PE and dense PVC branch tips for a softer touch to create a realistic Christmas tree; . Pre-attached hinged branch tips drop down automatically to make setting up your xmas tree easier; . Sectional trunk and foldable heavy-duty steel base allow for effortless seasonal storage; . Flame-retardant branch tips offer added safety against accidental fire risks; . Heavy-duty steel base ensures reliable stability to keep the tree standing steady; . Versatile seasonal accent suitable for living rooms, entryways and other indoor spaces; . Colour: Green; . Material: PE, PVC, Steel; . Overall Dimensions: F80 x 180H cm; . Base Dimensions: F45 x 15H cm; . Branch Tip Count: 1610; . Item Label: 83C-298V01GN; . Note: Approx. 30-50 minutes of manual branch tip shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness.
